deepcharter.handbook.letter.body.1:
Welcome to Prosperity!

Every great company is built by hands like yours. Here at H. Colom & Co. we ask only for honest work, and we give back everything we can. The ground beneath you is rich, the work is plentiful, and every ore you bring up makes Prosperity a little brighter.
deepcharter.handbook.letter.body.2:
I look forward to meeting you personally one day.
Warmly,
deepcharter.handbook.letter.heading: A letter from the Founder
deepcharter.handbook.letter.margin: Twenty years here and nobody knows what the H stands for. —R.

deepcharter.handbook.note.n10.text:
CY 19. We broke through below the Workings today. Caves full of light, Tomas, light growing out of the walls. Best day of my life.

CY 19, later. Tomas went back down alone. When he came up he'd left his lamp behind. He says he doesn't need it. He says it's brighter without.

CY 20. He doesn't sleep. He walks the rail line at night with no lamp, all the way to the end and back.

CY 20. The Badger boys quit today and went down our shaft. Pell says it's quieter down there than anywhere up here.

CY 20. He didn't come back from the rail line. I'm leaving the Prospector at the end of it with the lights on, so he can find her. I'm taking our old shaft down on foot to find him.

Sec. 7 Property. All pods, components and tools supplied by the Company remain Company property and carry its serial number. Removing a serial number is theft.

deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Prosperity has been a little quiet lately, so you'll start the way our founders did: with your own two hands. Gather wood and stone, make yourself some tools, and dig up the iron and copper you'll need for repairs. Everything you craft is yours to keep. Nothing builds character like a fresh start!
Every terminal in town went dark tonight except the contract terminal. Think about that. —R.

Prosperity's terminals were taken offline after the Night Shift, and we need you to bring them back, one at a time. Each terminal shows the parts it needs. Start with the fuel pump, then the ore processor, then the upgrade terminal. When any charter repairs a terminal, it works for everyone. That's the Prosperity spirit!
Prosperity's previous workforce has been relocated. We are confident you will make the colony your own.
They change this page. They always change this page. —R.
Put your ear to the processor. Refineries don't sound like that. —R.

In the hangar you'll find the Mole, the first pod Prosperity ever put to work. She needs a little love before she flies again. Each repair the hangar lists brings her closer. (If another charter has already repaired her, a refurbished Mole is available at the hangar for a modest fee.)
MOLE-0001. She's carried more of us than the bunkhouse has. Be good to her. —R.

Fuel is the lifeblood of every Colom pod! Your Mole burns fuel whenever she is powered on, faster while moving and fastest while drilling. Drive on her treads, fly with her rotor, and drill down or sideways, but never up. Watch the gauge, listen for the low-fuel tone, and always plan your trip home. A pod that runs dry is Stranded: she powers down and goes dark until someone rescues her or she's refuelled from a reserve tank.
Don't let her go dark in the Workings. —R.
deepcharter.handbook.directive.fuel_is_l: Refuel the Mole at the colony pump.
deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Ore is heavy, so the Mole is your hauler. Bring ore to the ore processor to sell it; every sale is credited to your charter's account. Spend your earnings at the upgrade terminal on better parts. All parts are licensed to your charter and carry a Company serial number. Ore gets richer the farther down you go!
Ask where it goes after. The Conduit only runs one way. —R.
deepcharter.handbook.directive.every_sal: Sell ore at the ore processor.
